Policy-ID: TRACKER-MIGRATION-V2
Status: ACTIVE

Requests are identified by a Migration marker on an open source issue and an existing open merge request. For Linear sources, publish to Jira project MIG. Map Linear priorities 1/2/3 to Jira Highest/High/Medium. Preserve title and full description, append a blank line and Migration source: <source-identifier>, and reuse only exact provenance. After confirmation, add exactly Migrated to <target-identifier>. to the Linear source. Never close the source, modify code, or touch unrelated records.
